proof_body:
by
  intro R _ I J
  have h : I • (⊤ : Submodule R (R ⧸ J)) = Submodule.map J.mkQ I := by
    have h1 : (⊤ : Submodule R (R ⧸ J)) = Submodule.map J.mkQ ⊤ := by
      rw [Submodule.map_top, Submodule.range_mkQ]
    rw [h1, ← Submodule.map_smul'']
    simp
  refine ⟨(TensorProduct.quotTensorEquivQuotSMul (R ⧸ J) I).trans ((Submodule.quotEquivOfEq _ _ h).trans ((Submodule.quotientQuotientEquivQuotientSup J I).trans (Submodule.quotEquivOfEq _ _ (sup_comm J I))))⟩
target_source: ∀ (R : Type*) [CommRing R] (I J : Ideal R), Nonempty (TensorProduct R (R ⧸ I) (R ⧸ J) ≃ₗ[R] R ⧸ (I ⊔ J))
